Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +18.71%) ABOVE TREND.

Financials lagging: JPM (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -5.36%) BELOW TREND. 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Technology mixed to weak: INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while MSFT (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -4.00%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.96% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.98% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND show broad pressure; sector 1W: -1.29% (19 stocks) — monitor earnings/news flow for re‑acceleration.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials softer: JPM (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -5.36%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -2.85% (20 stocks) — watch bank earnings and credit cues for spillover.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: JNJ (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND but ISRG (1W: -7.68% | 1M: +0.82%) CORRECTION and LLY (1W: -3.14% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION show dispersion; sector 1W: -0.92% (15 stocks) — selective stock moves tied to trial/news catalysts.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Value/Cyclical exposure given broad leadership in Energy, Industrials and Consumer Staples; consider names showing momentum such as LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +7.08% | 1M: +6.83%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to large-cap Tech with confirmed downside (MSFT, ADBE, CRM); Major Divergence among megacaps suggests a transitional market—monitor for trend breaks before adding fresh high‑beta exposure.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +11.50%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -4.00%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.96% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -5.36%) BELOW TREND.

NVDA (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +4.64%) CORRECTION — watch daily close above recent 1M high to signal resumption. AAPL (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -6.58%) BELOW TREND — failure to regain 1M trend keeps tech weak. JPM (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND — inability to stabilize into next earnings/credit print confirms Financials pressure.

INTC (+55): Sold‑out 2026 server capacity; INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. 15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (-60): Softer 2026 outlook; ISRG (1W: -7.68% | 1M: +0.82%) CORRECTION — price aligns with bearish revision. META (-50): layoffs headline; META (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -4.38%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. ADBE (-50): sell rating; ADBE (1W: -9.96% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND — confirming. MDLZ (-50): target cut; MDLZ (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price rising = divergence to monitor. BA (-50): probe headline; BA (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +18.71%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but strong price action, watch for sentiment spillover.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major divergence across megacaps (NVDA, AMZN, C in CORRECTION) and mixed news signals (MDLZ, BA price strength despite negative headlines) — watch for trend break.
